uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: After Ice Shard or Ice Beam is used, the user gains 10% damage resistance for 4s; after Icy Wind, Blizzard, or Unite Move is used the user gains 20% damage resistance for 5s. If move 1 or Unite Move is used after move 2 activated the ability, then the effect is dynamically upgraded to the improved version. Afterwards the ability goes on cooldown for 10s. Icy Wind, Blizzard, and Ice Wing Whiteout apply a freeze counter on opposing Pokémon when they hit. This freeze counter goes up to 5 stacks, lasts for 3s and refreshes when another stack is applied, and applies a stacking 12% slow based on the amount of stacks of the freeze counter. Once the freeze counter reaches 5 stacks, that Pokémon gets frozen for 1.1s.
The user hurls a shard of ice at the designated target, applying a 30% slow for 0.3s. Articuno has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

The user blasts a gust of chilled air in a cone, in the designated direction dealing damage and freezing the ground for a short while. Opposing Pokémon standing on the frozen ground will have their freeze counter increased over time.
The user summons a howling blizzard dealing damage and increasing the freeze counter on enemies hit.
Increases the amount of hits to 8.

The user hurls a chunk of ice in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and slowing them by 40% for 2.5s. If the target has at least 1 stack of the freeze counter, they will become frozen consuming the counter. If the target is already frozen the move instead deals increased damage.

The user fires a slow traveling beam of icy cold energy in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and slowing them by 30% for 2.5s. If the target has at least 1 stack of the freeze counter, they will become frozen consuming the counter. If the target is already frozen the move instead deals increased damage.
Increases the freeze duration to 2s when opponents are frozen by the move.

The user becomes Unstoppable and immobile, summoning a raging blizzard centered on themself, dealing damage in 5 waves. The second wave deals 5% more damage, third 10%, fourth 15%, and the fifth deals 100% more damage. If the move hits an ally goal zone, a chunk of ice forms on the zone, blocking movement and scoring. The goal zone still provides healing and shielding by standing at the edge of it. This chunk of ice will remain until it is destroyed. 9000 HP, 0 Def and SpDef. Unaffected by some status effects and damage over time.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
